Broadcom has arranged a $63 billion financing deal with Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley to fund the purchase of chips for Anthropic, routed through a new special purpose vehicle. It is the second nine-figure chip-financing structure tied to Anthropic's demand this week, and another sign that the AI build-out increasingly runs through Wall Street's structured-finance machinery.
